opportunities.name: Solo frost attack
opportunities.objective: Test faster self attacks to enable E without allied melee help.
opportunities.mechanic: W contributes Permafrost stacks and nearby melee allies can add stacks, but solo testing must count only Sejuani's own actions. Nashor and Dusk support real attacks; E has 0.7 AP and the passive shatter adds target-health magic damage after her stun. Health also strengthens both W swings.
opportunities.requiredState: No allied stack contribution, unstunned target and four verified stacks before E.
opportunities.failure: Slow stack delivery loses E access or expiring armor leaves the attacker vulnerable.
opportunities.test: Count stacks per W swing and ordinary attack, then isolate E and first post-stun attack packets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated on-hits are not proven to add extra Permafrost stacks.

opportunities.name: Health flail resistance
opportunities.objective: Combine health-scaled physical W with a deliberately refreshed Frost Armor entry.
opportunities.mechanic: W includes 4% and 8% health Stat terms over its two swings; Cleaver can benefit its confirmed physical packets. Passive Frost Armor adds resistance after avoiding champion/large-monster damage, while Warmog supports disengage and health budget. E then supplies a stun for the shatter attack.
opportunities.requiredState: Frost Armor refreshed before Q entry and finite health/bonus resistance state recorded.
opportunities.failure: Incidental large-monster damage delays armor refresh or W's second swing misses.
opportunities.test: Compare W hits and incoming damage with Frost Armor active versus expired at equal health.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Frost Armor is not continuously active merely because resistance items are equipped.

ruledOut.reason: W shows AP and health Stat terms; armor principally changes survival and Frost Armor.

unknowns: Permafrost stun immunity/order, shatter eligibility and raw resistance/health Stat flags require observation.

builds.name: Solo frost attack
builds.summary: Test faster self attacks to enable E without allied melee help.
builds.goal: Test faster self attacks to enable E without allied melee help.
builds.hypothesis: W contributes Permafrost stacks and nearby melee allies can add stacks, but solo testing must count only Sejuani's own actions. Nashor and Dusk support real attacks; E has 0.7 AP and the passive shatter adds target-health magic damage after her stun. Health also strengthens both W swings.
testPlan: Required state: No allied stack contribution, unstunned target and four verified stacks before E.
Count stacks per W swing and ordinary attack, then isolate E and first post-stun attack packets.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Slow stack delivery loses E access or expiring armor leaves the attacker vulnerable.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated on-hits are not proven to add extra Permafrost stacks.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Abyssal Mask, Rabadon's Deathcap, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Sejuani becomes immune to Slows and gains [10 + (0.75) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2]] Armor and [10 + (0.75) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] Magic Resist after not taking damage from champions or large jungle monsters for [characterLevelInterpolation(12 → 6; raw flags preserved)] seconds.

Sejuani's first Attack against enemies she has Stunned deals an additional [0.1] max Health magic damage.

Passive: Nearby melee allied champions' Attacks apply a stack to champions and jungle monsters.

Active: Sejuani deals [55 / 105 / 155 / 205 / 255 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage to target enemy with 4 stacks and Stuns them for [1] second.

Sejuani swings her flail, dealing [5 / 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 + (0.3) × AP + (0.04) × Stat(12)] physical damage and Knocking Back minions and jungle monsters. She then lashes out again, dealing [5 / 25 / 45 / 65 / 85 + (0.6) × AP + (0.08) × Stat(12)] physical damage and briefly Slowing targets.

Both swings apply stacks of Permafrost.
